DESCRIPTION: The PERSON_MASTER table contains one record for each patient known to the system, with demographic and registration details.
This table holds further demographic details of each patient, including the birth history and the date of death where it is known.
This table contains one record for each hospital encounter, from admission to discharge, including day stays.
The list of wards and units of the hospital.
This table contains one record for each surgical case booked in the operating theatre, with its status, room, service and urgency.
This table lists the procedures performed during a surgical case.
The list of procedures that can be booked for a surgical case.
This table stores one record for each anesthesia episode documented by the anesthesia team.
This table lists the staff who took part in an anesthesia episode and their roles.
The list of staff members who can be assigned to a case.
This table contains the timed events documented during an anesthesia episode.
The list of event types that can be documented on the anesthesia record.
This table contains one record for each observation sheet, which groups the observations charted for an encounter or an anesthesia episode.
This table contains the patient-specific observations and measurements charted on an observation sheet.
The list of observation types that can be charted.
This table contains one record for each medication administration charted for a patient.
The list of medications in the hospital's formulary.
The category list of physical status grades.
The category list of case statuses.
The category list of sexes.
The category list of routes of administration.
The category list of surgical services.
This table contains one record for each airway device, line or catheter placed for a patient.
This table lists the diagnoses recorded for a hospital encounter.
The list of diagnoses.
